message.subject: Jishnu, quick question
message.html:
Hi Jishnu,

When new software needs come up at CloudBaud, LLC., what usually drives the decision... speed, cost, control, or something else?

Do you tend to build fully in-house, or bring in external teams when things spike?

Curious how you think about it.

Robert
